# Issue drafts

These are reviewed-in-the-repo drafts for good first issues. Each file has YAML front matter
(`title`, `labels`) and a body. Open them on GitHub with the PowerShell script in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) (or the maintainer's notes), editing drafts here first so
they can be reviewed like code and re-synced.

| # | Title | Labels |
|---|---|---|
| 01 | docs: GETTING-STARTED lists got/undici as unsupported, but they are | documentation, good first issue |
| 02 | feat(cli): add a `--version` flag | enhancement, good first issue |
| 03 | test(cli): cover the `verify` command | chore, good first issue |
| 04 | docs(contributing): add a "Your first contribution" section | documentation, good first issue |
| 05 | feat(cli): `can-i-deploy --quiet` to print only the verdict | enhancement, good first issue |
| 06 | docs: document the `--version` / `-v` flag in README + CLI help | documentation, good first issue |
| 07 | docs: add got and undici recording snippets to GETTING-STARTED | documentation, good first issue |
| 08 | feat(cli): add `--json` output to the `verify` command | enhancement, good first issue |

Keep 3–5 open at any time; when one closes, open the next draft. (#1 and #2 shipped in 1.7.0.)
